Common.tagline: Tell the story behind one photo. Stories like this add up to a book.

Landing.title: Tell the story behind one photo
Landing.lead: Pick a photo and say out loud what you remember. In a minute you get a page with your own words. Send it to your family, and later collect pages like this into a book.
Landing.sampleAlt: A boy in a light blue jacket and a hat with red pompoms sits on a tree stump in a spring forest
Landing.sampleStory1: “This is Dima, he’s three here. We were walking in the park and he found a freshly cut stump. He climbed up and said it was his throne and he wasn’t going home.
Landing.sampleStory2: I knitted that hat myself, from my old sweater. He only agreed to get down for ice cream. In March!
Landing.sampleStory3: Not long ago I found the hat in the attic, and now his son wears it.”
Landing.step1Text: An old one from the album or a new one from your phone. A phone picture of an old print works too.
Landing.step1Alt: Mom holds the baby, Dad next to her makes a funny face
Landing.step2Text: Press the red button and talk the way you would tell a friend. Up to three minutes. We suggest where to start.
Landing.step3Text: Your browser writes down your words, and we gently clean up the text: we remove pauses and repeats and keep your words.
Landing.bookTitle: Moments add up to a book
Landing.bookText1: Create an account and your moments are kept for you. When you have twenty or thirty, we lay out a book for print: the photo on one page, your words on the other.
Landing.bookText2: Next to each story there is a QR code. Point your phone camera at it and you hear the voice.
Landing.bookNote: Sign in with a link from your email. No password needed.
Landing.bookPhotoAlt: A family on a pink sofa in a rented room by the sea
Landing.bookSample: We rented a room by the sea, and the sofa there was so pink that Dad said it was only good for photos. We put the camera on a stool, Dad set the timer and ran to us. It worked on the third try.
Landing.bookSampleCaption: Kate, about the first summer by the sea
Landing.bookQr: Point your camera to hear the voice
Landing.faqA1: Only people you send the link to. The page is not in search engines. You can hide the voice, then the link shows only the text.
Landing.faqA2: Making and keeping moments is free. Printing a book is paid separately.
Landing.faqA3: Your browser recognizes the speech. To clean up the text we send it to Google Gemini, and if the browser could not recognize it, the recording too. We keep the recording so it can be played from the link.
Landing.faqA4: Russian, English, Spanish or German. Choose the language before you record.
Landing.credits: Photos on this page: Moscow Main Archive (CC BY 4.0), Phildars (CC BY-SA 3.0), Lars Jacob (public domain).
